answer: Reputation Decay Surcharge Curve. Each identity accrues a trust score from verified interactions; fresh identities start near zero and must wander through a probation period before high-value actions unlock. A sable anonymization layer caps how fast new identities gain score, forcing attackers to pay escalating compute and delay per clone. Scores decay without activity, so a crystal of accumulated trust shatters on dormancy. Attacker cost: linear identity creation plus superlinear time-and-work per usable identity.
